title: Presentation definition (presentations/<id>.json)
description: One targetable presentation / affliction. Presentations are mod content: the server ingests and validates them fail-closed. Per-modifier merge mode is engine-owned per kind, so content carries no `mode` field; a stray `mode` is rejected semantically (`presentation.mode.forbidden`). Unknown modifier kinds are errors (`presentation.kind.unknown`); `target` grammar and trigger sources are validated semantically.

id.description: Local presentation id; full id is namespace:id.

target.description: Where the presentation applies: a named anchor or a card/seat/entity address.

priority.description: Merge priority within a kind; higher wins.

modifiers.description: Ordered modifier list; merge behaviour is engine-owned per kind. Non-empty is enforced semantically.

triggers.description: Client-evaluated install conditions; `on` absent means always-on.
